posts.body:
So I recently shared on this forum about how after years, I've always struggled to finish my projects, and on this thread, I got encourage by a user with the nickname "Tridium" to publish about my project on the forum, which is exactly what am I doing RN.
I don't know if for like weekly updates or anything I've to use this same thread, or make a new one, so if anyone can tell me, I would be glad.
[IMPORTANT]
I was about to put this at the end, but I think it's important enough to open the introduction with it. And it's the fact this project it does include use of AI for the creation of images and music, HOWEVER, we talk about what will be a totally free project made by a single person who's not really expecting to get any money, so spending on RPG maker, and the license to publish it on steam will already be a big bet (on my country, 100 bucks can brought like two weeks groceries for my family).
On this case, the images are generated by the AI, and I correct the pixel arts (I would rather spend 3 hours correcting everything, than 3 hours making a single pixel art.
On the music part, I was planning on using military marches from around the world, they tend to become public domain due to how old are these songs, but guess what? that does not make the performances public domain, I've no clue on how to make music, and it's quite impossible to find a free copyrighted performance online, being almost the only exceptions USSR and some old Germany Songs (I wonder why). So I've made the decision to let an IA make those songs, which ain't so bad honestly, they work good enough for what I need them.
[Synopsis]
Rose Bullet it's a secret worldwide military organization which has been working for almost a century. They recruit young girls from orphanages, take them to their base, and train them to become soldiers with lethal experience by a young age, granting quality and decades of service.
Here, you got to have three main characters:
- Heady. She's also called D-59848, it's the leader of your squad, who's been in the organization since she was a baby, and was chosen to become the squad leader since a young age. She also works as the main front line, being able to equip the heaviest armors, and weaponry.
- Thany, also called D-44561, it's the combat medic, also been in the organization since she was really young. Even with the only lifestyle she knows, it has not stopped her on being positive and cheerful, which helps with the morale of her teammates.
- Nina, or as named by their superiors, E-1254, it's the military engineer of the team, which is also the oldest to ever been added to the organization, entering with already 14 years old; normally they would not accept that age, but her normal life did showed she had a brilliant future, so they couldn't waste the opportunity to have one of the best engineers that this organization ever had.
But, why little girls on the first place? well, having choosing both, boys and girls, might end up with some problematic situation once they grew up. On the other hand, with only guys, the training would end up being harder, since they would be overall more competitive. [ISPOILER]But honestly, it's just the in-lore excuse, since this project originated as "anime girls with guns" but I promise, it has become much more, specially lore wise.[/ISPOILER]
[Gameplay]
Instead of a classical RPG game made with this engines, I decided to run for a tactical RPG game (I know on the steam page there's already a free plugin for it, but I didn't knew that, and at least haven't seen much people doing this type of game).
Also I wanted to go for class types, which do kinda go a little bit different from the usual types.
The leader does indeed is like the tank, but also as a DPS, having automatic weapons with great dmg. (yet, it won't be the only one making DMG)
The medic it's self explanatory, the healer of the team.
The engineer it's more of a support class, being able to produce debuffs and some other abilities to assist the rest of the team.
There's another class, which I've not introduce yet, since you do not start with this one, but to simplify it, we got a sniper as well.
My intention is to actually make a hard game, not just on the combat strategy, but also in terms of resources, since you do need to buy all your resources (this includes the ammo). So choosing between getting something like ammo or bandages might come to your mind from time to time.
Although heady might sound like the carry or the only one making DMG, all of them do actually need to be involved on the combat, since the TP, or as it's called on the game, Adrenaline, it's needed for the skills they have. These skills is what makes them differ from the others, the engineer is only able to pop out with the skills she'll be learning with the XP, like improving the hit-rate for one of the team members, or giving them some cover. The combat medic also works this way, it's the only character which can heal without the need of buying bandages, but needs adrenaline for this skill. (and adrenaline cannot be gained by waiting)
[Plugins]
I do not have plans on adding much stuff, I wanna make this as simple as possible in terms of plugins, but here's a list of the ones I got:
- Yanfly Item core
- Yanfly Skillcore
- Yanfly Keyboard Config
- SRPG battle system - gajuto mikagami, dr. Q
- Dynamic animation - Takeshi Sunagawa
- Galv ScreenZoom
- MouseOperation - RyanBram
Planned plugins to add:
- Translation Engine (by SomeRanDev)
[What to Expect]
First of all, this game will be completely free. I MIGHT create a patreon or something to support if you would like, BUT I won't do anything like that until I at least have this finished and published.
I'll start college in like two weeks, so this game might delay a little bit, but I'll be looking forward on making the game available by the end of the year.
With the translation Engine, I only have planed to have the game available on English and Spanish, for now, it's all on spanish.

I've got here a playtest on Youtube where you can give it a check.
